analysis.title: GS TWIG Notes: This Week in Global Research - November 20, 2026
key_insights: US 2027 outlook: GS forecasts above-consensus GDP growth of 2.4% Q4/Q4 on fading inflation, strong business investment, a resilient consumer and a low-hire, low-fire labor market. Stance is buy stocks and bonds, not credit.
Fed path: GS expects two more 25bp hikes in December and March, then gradual cuts starting November 2027.
Global rates: high starting yields, fading hawkish risks and better hedge value support government bond total returns (Will Marshall).
US equities: Ben Snider forecasts an 18% S&P 500 total return, driven by 18% EPS growth and a stable 18x P/E. Key watch item is 2028 and beyond as investors question AI trade sustainability.
Positioning: hyperscalers, FCF-rich companies returning cash, structural growth and defensive diversification.
Credit: higher rates, elevated volatility and a peaking AI growth impulse mean the cycle is increasingly mature, so GS expects suboptimal returns.
Asia: decelerating AI growth meets a fading energy crisis, leaving above-trend growth for most economies. Japan supported by real wage growth and capex despite higher rates and inflation.
Asia equities: 19% MXAPJ return forecast. China H and India raised to OW, Taiwan and China A cut to MW. MSCI China upside 23%. Mexico upgraded to Overweight in EM.
Europe: Euro area 2027 growth forecast 0.9%, below potential and consensus, on high energy prices, tighter credit and French stagnation. UK 2027 growth 1.4% Q4/Q4, above consensus.
Cross-asset: modestly pro-risk for 12 months, Overweight equities and 10-year government bonds, Underweight credit, Neutral commodities. Constructive on gold.
US-China regulation: Commerce interim final rule on remote access to advanced chips tightens China's access to US AI compute. China's AI labs most exposed, large integrated internet firms less so.
China AI chips: domestic market seen growing +102% CAGR 2025-30E to US$678bn. NVDA CY27 revenue growth forecast 75%, with risks from export rules, data center delays and leadership transition.
Power and alts: favor TLN, VST, NRG on Texas load growth. Alt managers see re-accelerating fee growth in 2027, Buy TPG (on CL), APO, STEP, CG.

Tech and industrial trips: neocloud bifurcation, scale-up Ethernet opportunity, strong 800V and liquid cooling demand. Favor NVT, ETN, VRT, JCI, FLEX, APH. Solar utility-scale resilient, resi subdued, favor NXT. Shipbuilding demand robust into early 2030s.
Energy and other: LNG FID wave expanding, favor GTT, SBM Offshore initiated at Buy. Europe biopharma favored. Upgrades to Buy at Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank, Whitbread, UNFI. GAP cut to Sell.
